en: Welcome to the Dragon Shrine. Here the dragon tamers of Blackthorn learn what it means to be strong.
When the time is right, I will ask you some questions. Not yet.
Have you heard of Lugia? They say it lived around the Whirl Islands once... Pay no mind. An old man's rambling.
Ah, good, you came back. I have something for you. Take this Dratini as a sign that I know your worth.
Dragons stand for our clan. You have shown that one can be trusted to you.
Clair seems to have learned something worth knowing from you. I thank you, as her grandfather.
Hm. Good to see you. You needn't tell me why you're here: Clair sent you. That girl is a handful.
I'm sorry, but I must test you. Don't worry: you need only answer a few questions. Ready?
Shall we go on? I believe I was asking you...
What kind of trainer do you want to battle?
What matters most in raising Pokémon?
Strong Pokémon or weak Pokémon: which matter more?
Hm... I see. You care deeply for Pokémon. That is the conviction that matters most.
{player}, hold on to it. It will carry you through the Pokémon League.
Well? How did it go? There's no point asking, I suppose. You failed, didn't you? ...What? You passed?
You're lying! Even I've never had his approval!
Clair! This child has no flaw, in skill or in heart. Accept your defeat and give the Rising Badge... or must I tell Lance about this?
Here. This is the Rising Badge. Hurry up and take it!
{player} received the Rising Badge from Clair!
With it your Pokémon can climb waterfalls, and every Pokémon you have will obey you without question.
Clair... Think about what this child has, and what you lack.
By the way... have you heard of Lugia? They say it lived around the Whirl Islands once... Pay no mind. An old man's rambling.
Hm? I didn't quite catch that...
What was it you said? Think it over, and speak to me again when you're ready.
